Who is IAS Kumar Ravi, and why is he being compared to Maharashtra's Tukaram Mundhe?
Bihar's Food Safety Department has intensified inspections and raids targeting food adulteration, expired products, unhygienic restaurants, and food storage violations.
Under IAS Kumar Ravi, Bihar's Food Safety Commissioner, officials conducted 531 inspections across 38 districts in three months. From expired milk found at a Blinkit store to contaminated food samples and hotel inspections, the campaign has raised serious questions about food safety in Bihar.
